description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to Amend the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 published under the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka refering the  heading, Minister of National Integration & Reconciliation
reasoning: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena and outlines detailed portfolio responsibilities for the Minister of National Integration & Reconciliation, including specific subjects (Office on Missing Persons Act, supervision of organizations) and organizational oversight.
